name: spring.new
title: spring.new
shortDescription: spring.new enables users to create custom business applications quickly using AI. It is designed to cater to businesses needing rapid app development with seamless integrations. Users can transform their ideas into functional apps using natural language and deploy them in various environments. An example use case could be a small business automating their internal processes without extensive coding knowledge.
